arxiv-2202-10097.title: Equivariant Lagrangian Floer homology via cotangent bundles of E ​ G N EG_{N} Thanks: This work was funded by EPSRC grant reference EP/T012749/1.
arxiv-2202-10097.creator: Guillem Cazassus
arxiv-2202-10097.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Guillem Cazassus. We provide a construction of equivariant Lagrangian Floer homology H ​ F G ​ ( L 0 , L 1 ) HF_{G}(L_{0},L_{1}) , for a compact Lie group G G acting on a symplectic manifold M M in a Hamiltonian fashion, and a pair of G G -Lagrangian submanifolds L 0 , L 1 ⊂ M L_{0},L_{1}\subset M . We do so by using symplectic homotopy quotients involving cotangent bundles of an approximation of E ​ G EG .

arxiv-2205-12126.title: Estimation and Inference for High Dimensional Factor Model with Regime Switching
arxiv-2205-12126.creator: Giovanni Urga, Fa Wang
arxiv-2205-12126.description: Abstract This paper proposes maximum (quasi)likelihood estimation for high dimensional factor models with regime switching in the loadings. The model parameters are estimated jointly by the EM (expectation maximization) algorithm, which in the current context only requires iteratively calculating regime probabilities and principal components of the weighted sample covariance matrix.

arxiv-2210-17286.title: Near-Infrared 3D Imaging with Upconversion Detection Journal: pr
arxiv-2210-17286.creator: He Zhang, Santosh Kumar, Yong Meng Sua, Shenyu Zhu, Yu-Ping Huang
arxiv-2210-17286.description: Abstract We demonstrate a photon-sensitive, three-dimensional camera by active near-infrared illumination and fast time-of-flight gating. It uses pico-second pump pulses to selectively up-convert the backscattered photons according to their spatiotemporal modes via sum-frequency generation in a χ 2 \chi^{2} nonlinear crystal, which are then detected by electron-multiplying CCD with photon sensitive detection.

arxiv-2308-07177.title: Conformance Checking for Pushdown Reactive Systems based on Visibly Pushdown Languages
arxiv-2308-07177.creator: Adilson Luiz Bonifacio
arxiv-2308-07177.description: Abstract Testing pushdown reactive systems is deemed important to guarantee a precise and robust software development process. Usually, such systems can be specified by the formalism of Input/Output Visibly Pushdown Labeled Transition System (IOVPTS), where the interaction with the environment is regulated by a pushdown memory.

arxiv-2311-08574.title: Estimating the volumes of correlations sets in causal networks
arxiv-2311-08574.creator: Giulio Camillo, Pedro Lauand, Davide Poderini, Rafael Rabelo, Rafael Chaves
arxiv-2311-08574.description: Abstract Causal networks beyond that in the paradigmatic Bell’s theorem can lead to new kinds and applications of non-classical behavior. Their study, however, has been hindered by the fact that they define a non-convex set of correlations and only very incomplete or approximated descriptions have been obtained so far, even for the simplest scenarios.

arxiv-2406-01541.title: Adaptive discretization algorithms for locally optimal experimental design
arxiv-2406-01541.creator: Jochen Schmid, Philipp Seufert, Michael Bortz Fraunhofer Institute for Industrial Mathematics (ITWM), 67663 Kaiserslautern, Germany jochen.schmid@itwm.fraunhofer.de
arxiv-2406-01541.description: Abstract We develop adaptive discretization algorithms for locally optimal experimental design of nonlinear prediction models. With these algorithms, we refine and improve a pertinent state-of-the-art algorithm in various respects. We establish novel termination, convergence, and convergence rate results for the proposed algorithms.

arxiv-2410-15031.title: The Constrained Layer Tree Problem and Applications to Solar Farm Cabling
arxiv-2410-15031.creator: Thomas Bläsius, Max Göttlicher, Sascha Gritzbach, Wendy Yi
arxiv-2410-15031.description: Abstract Motivated by the cabling of solar farms, we study the problem Constrained Layer Tree . At its core, it asks whether there exists a tree that connects a set of sources (the leaves) to one sink (the root) such that certain capacity constraints at the inner nodes are satisfied.

arxiv-2510-11351.title: REBELS-IFU: Linking damped Lyman- α \alpha absorption to [C ii ] emission and dust content in the EoR
arxiv-2510-11351.creator: Lucie E. Rowland ,, Kasper E. Heintz, Hiddo Algera, Mauro Stefanon, Jacqueline Hodge, Rychard Bouwens, Manuel Aravena, Elisabete da Cunha, Pratika Dayal, Andrea Ferrara, Rebecca Fisher, Valentino González, Hanae Inami, Olena Komarova, Ilse de Looze, Themiya Nanayakkara, Katherine Ormerod, Andrea Pal
arxiv-2510-11351.description: Abstract Neutral gas in galaxies during the Epoch of Reionisation (EoR) regulates star formation, dust growth, and the escape of ionising photons, making it a key ingredient in understanding both galaxy assembly and reionisation. Yet, direct constraints on the H i content of galaxies at z > 6 z>6 have been scarce.

pmc-10741072.title: Activity of Cinnamic Acid Derivatives with 4-Chloro-2-mercaptobenzenesulfonamide Moiety against Clinical HLAR and VRE Enterococcus spp.
pmc-10741072.creator: Rafał Hałasa, Anita Bułakowska, Jarosław Sławiński, Magdalena Smoktunowicz, Aleksandra Rapacka-Zdończyk, Urszula Mizerska, Marc Maresca
pmc-10741072.description: The rapid increase in strains that are resistant to antibiotics requires new active compounds to be found whose mechanism of action on bacteria is different to those that are currently known. Of particular interest are compounds that occur in plants as secondary metabolites.

pmc-11313074.title: Estrogen Hormones’ Implications on the Physiopathology of Temporomandibular Dysfunction
pmc-11313074.creator: Daniel-Corneliu Leucuța, Damaris Anton, Oana Almășan, Cosmin Sinescu, Elena Amaricai, Virgil-Florin Duma
pmc-11313074.description: Background/Objectives: Temporomandibular dysfunction syndrome consists of several disorders of the masticatory system, namely those of the muscles, the joint itself, as well as the dental and periodontal system. This syndrome is often characterized by pain and an inability to perform functions within the dental–maxillary apparatus, which creates a certain degree of disability in patients.

pmc-11485230.title: Spectral location for the universal scaling regime in Martian atmospheric turbulence
pmc-11485230.creator: Miya C Y Coimbra, Manuel de la Torre Juárez, Beverley J McKeon, Mercedes Marín, Naomi Murdoch, Sara Navarro, José Antonio Rodríguez-Manfredi, Alexander Stott
pmc-11485230.description: Atmospheric turbulence, irregular fluctuations of the fluid state, is studied on Mars. Universality of the turbulence spectrum underpins atmospheric models where computational requirements preclude full fidelity simulations of the smallest scales. However, there are discrepancies among reports on the existence and spectral location of universal scaling in Martian atmospheric data.

pmc-11604820.title: Raphe and ventrolateral medulla proteomics in sudden unexplained death in childhood with febrile seizure history
pmc-11604820.creator: Dominique F Leitner, Christopher William, Arline Faustin, Evgeny Kanshin, Matija Snuderl, Declan McGuone, Thomas Wisniewski, Beatrix Ueberheide, Laura Gould, Orrin Devinsky
pmc-11604820.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Sudden unexplained death in childhood (SUDC) is death of a child ≥ 12 months old that is unexplained after autopsy and detailed analyses. Among SUDC cases, ~ 30% have febrile seizure (FS) history, versus 2–5% in the general population. SUDC cases share features with sudden unexpected death in epilepsy (SUDEP) and sudden infant death syndrome (SIDS), in which brainstem autonomic dysfunction is implicated.

pmc-12745683.title: Rising rates of wildfire building destruction in the conterminous United States
pmc-12745683.creator: Amanda R. Carlson, Todd J. Hawbaker, Miranda H. Mockrin, Volker C. Radeloff, Lucas S. Bair, Michael D. Caggiano, James R. Meldrum, Patricia M. Alexandre, H. Anu Kramer, Paul F. Steblein
pmc-12745683.description: SignificanceHighly destructive wildfires are occurring more frequently across the globe, prompting debates over the causes for this increase and effective management responses. We investigated building destruction trends in the United States by mapping buildings that were exposed to and destroyed by wildfires over two decades.

pmc-13477624.title: Structural Effect of Informational-Motivational-Behavioral Skills and Acceptance-Commitment in Self-Management, Adherence, and HbA1c in Diabetes: The Mediating Role of Distress
pmc-13477624.creator: Zahra Heidari Archandani, Isaac Rahimian-Boogar
pmc-13477624.description: Objective: Psychological and behavioral factors play a critical role in diabetes management. This study investigates the structural relationships among the informational-motivational-behavioral skills (IMB) and acceptance and commitment processes with self-management, treatment adherence, and Glycated hemoglobin (HbA1c) levels in diabetic patients, with distress as a mediator.

pmc-13535676.title: Digitally Planned Reconstruction of a Case of Mandibular Central Giant Cell Granuloma in a Young Female: A Case Report
pmc-13535676.creator: Harish Saluja, Anuj Dadhich, Seemit Shah, Shivani Sachdeva
pmc-13535676.description: Reconstruction of maxillofacial continuity defects has invariably been a difficult task for oral and maxillofacial surgeons over the years. Maxillofacial bone defects are caused by the trauma, clefts, burns, and infection, benign, or malignant tumors. To reconstruct big bony defects within the head and neck region remains a serious surgical challenge.

pmc-13546564.title: Early hypoalbuminemia during zolbetuximab therapy in gastroesophageal adenocarcinoma: a retrospective observational study
pmc-13546564.creator: Fares Jamal, Cody Eslinger, Abdullah Alsulaiman, Tanios Bekaii-Saab, Hao Xie, Daniel Ahn, Jason S. Starr, Jake Jochum, Nguyen H. Tran, Mojun Zhu, Ben George, Caitlin B. Conboy, Conor D. J. O’Donnell, Jamie Bering, Harry H. Yoon, Mohamad Bassam Sonbol
pmc-13546564.description: BackgroundZolbetuximab has improved survival in claudin 18.2 (CLDN18.2)-positive gastroesophageal adenocarcinoma (GEA). Hypoalbuminemia was reported in phase III trials. However, the timing, magnitude, and clinical phenotype of serum protein decline remain incompletely characterized. This study aimed to characterize changes in serum albumin and total protein during zolbetuximab therapy and their associated clinical findings.
